#separator:: What is a DNS zone transfer (AXFR)?
column2: Bulk copy of a zone's records; if misconfigured to allow anyone, it leaks the whole namespace.

#separator:: Command to attempt a zone transfer?
column2: dig @<nameserver> <domain> AXFR (or host -l <domain> <ns>).
